a.speaker: Ruth Pellow
a.text:
Ruth waves you up onto the porch. She has an index-card box on her knees.

"The check-on chain. If the power goes, every house gets a knock inside a day. It only works if somebody walks it once so people believe in it. I need a list of who runs on a plug: oxygen, insulin, a CPAP. And I need this card in Marisol Quan's hand. She stopped answering the door for me."

options.text: "{partner.name} can tell you who's on what. Nurses know."

org.speaker: Ruth Pellow
org.text:
You have the list on two cards before her tea goes cold.

[How it works] That option was a skill check. Checks never roll dice: if your skill meets the number, it works. If you are a little short, MAKE DO lets you push through anyway and costs Strain. A family member standing with you can Assist.

org_fail.speaker: Ruth Pellow
org_fail.text:
You get halfway and lose track of who is on what. Ruth takes the cards back, kindly.

[How it works] You were too far short of that skill check, so it failed. Night Class or practice raises a skill; Make Do covers small gaps at a Strain cost.

options.text: "At least let me carry the card."

family.speaker: Ruth Pellow
family.text:
{partner.name} rattles off half the street from memory. Ruth writes fast.

[How it works] Some options only appear when a family member trusts you enough. That is Buy-in: time together raises it.

card.speaker: Ruth Pellow
card.text:
She presses a card into your hand: a phone tree, three names, a time to knock. "West side, the house with the wind chimes. Tap her door."

[How it works] A task now sits in your Journal. The gold marker on the map shows where it goes.

effects: Ruth's card: take it to Marisol Quan's door.

later.speaker: Ruth Pellow
later.text: "The street will still be here next week. Probably."
